title: eclair platform website launched
body: The platform website has been launched. You can suggest any modifications.

title: AFM setup delivery!
meta: The AFM setup has been delivered at ESPCI
body: Our AFM setup arrived on the 2nd of November. Stressful day but hopefully, and especially thanks to Bovis workers, everything went well! Big thanks to everyone for this stressful but successful delivery
gallery: Heavy Truck for Heavy material delivery
Bovis's professional workers in charge of the delivery: Thanks to them, everything went well

title: AFM installed and ready
meta: The AFM-SECM has been set up in its new room at ESPCI
body: Following its delivery on November 2nd, our new Atomic Force Microscope has now been fully installed, together with its glovebox and acoustic enclosure. The instrument room is set up and the system is being readied for calibration ahead of opening it up for use on the platform.
gallery: The AFM fully installed next to its glovebox
Entrance to the eclair AFM room

title: eclair is now on LinkedIn!
body: We've just launched the eclair platform's official LinkedIn page. Follow us there for updates on our research, equipment and training programmes: https://fr.linkedin.com/company/eclair-research-espci
